regulatory.name: UK Medical Devices Regulations — Class I
regulatory.summary: Launch classification as a mobility aid with safety features; no notified body required at Class I but technical file and registration with MHRA mandatory.

regulatory.name: UK Medical Devices Regulations — Class IIa
regulatory.summary: Upgrade path once the cellular emergency-call pathway is validated; requires UK Approved Body conformity assessment.

regulatory.name: UK Conformity Assessed — Radio Equipment Regulations 2017
regulatory.summary: Cellular module (nRF9160) carries module-level certification; full product UKCA marking required for UK market placement.

regulatory.name: Conformité Européenne — Radio Equipment Directive 2014/53/EU
regulatory.summary: Module-level CE RED certification on nRF9160 typically carries to product level; required if sold in EU.

regulatory.name: Ofcom Spectrum Compliance (UK)
regulatory.summary: LTE-M/NB-IoT radio use compliant via nRF9160 module certification; eSIM provisioning to follow GSMA SGP.02 embedded SIM specification.

regulatory.name: Safety for portable sealed secondary lithium cells and batteries
regulatory.summary: Battery pack compliance required for UK/EU market; covers overcharge, short circuit, and thermal protection.

regulatory.name: Household and similar electrical appliances — Safety
regulatory.summary: Governs the mains-powered inductive charging stand as a household appliance.

regulatory.name: Assistive products for walking — Walking sticks
regulatory.summary: Governing structural and load standard for walking sticks on the UK market; shaft and telescoping joint must meet stated static and dynamic load cases.

regulatory.name: EMC — Electrostatic discharge immunity
regulatory.summary: Handle is a frequently grasped surface; contact discharge immunity to ±4 kV minimum recommended.

regulatory.name: Generic Standard on Printed Board Design
regulatory.summary: PCB design standard governing clearance, current capacity, and via sizing for the long narrow shaft-cavity board.

regulatory.name: Requirements for the Connection of Generation Equipment in Parallel with Public Distribution Networks above 16 A
regulatory.summary: Mandatory UK grid code for behind-the-meter storage connecting in parallel with the distribution network; grid-forming capability required.

regulatory.name: Safety requirements for secondary lithium cells and batteries for use in industrial applications
regulatory.summary: Cell-level safety certification required for the LFP modules within the system.

regulatory.name: Safety requirements for secondary lithium cells and batteries for use in electrical energy storage systems
regulatory.summary: System-level safety certification required for the complete BESS installation.

regulatory.name: Standard for Energy Storage Systems and Equipment
regulatory.summary: System-level listing recommended to support NFCC alignment for planning and fire authority approval.

regulatory.name: Test Method for Evaluating Thermal Runaway Fire Propagation in Battery Energy Storage Systems
regulatory.summary: Thermal-runaway propagation test recommended to demonstrate fire safety in support of NFCC guidance compliance.

regulatory.name: Standard for the Installation of Stationary Energy Storage Systems
regulatory.summary: Governs minimum fire separation distances, deflagration venting, and suppression requirements; referenced by NFCC planning guidance.

regulatory.name: Series 1 freight containers — specification and testing
regulatory.summary: Defines the structural and dimensional standard for the 40 ft High Cube container shell.

regulatory.name: Series 1 freight containers — corner fittings
regulatory.summary: Specifies corner casting geometry used for lifting, transport, and foundation anchorage.

regulatory.name: Drinking water system components — health effects
regulatory.summary: All potable-water-contact materials and components must be certified under this standard

regulatory.name: Drinking water system components — lead content
regulatory.summary: All potable-water-contact components must comply with lead-free requirements

regulatory.name: Series 1 freight containers — specification and testing
regulatory.summary: Container shell must conform to this standard for structural integrity and intermodal compatibility

regulatory.name: WHO potable water quality guidelines
regulatory.summary: Permeate TDS target of less than 500 mg/L and residual chlorine 0.2–0.5 mg/L align with WHO potable-water thresholds

regulatory.name: Degrees of protection — enclosures (IP65)
regulatory.summary: Electrical control panel must meet IP65 ingress-protection rating for outdoor and coastal environments

scores.summary: The output is a useful initial list of relevant regimes, but it reads like a standards bibliography rather than an expert compliance matrix with UK-specific applicability, evidence, ownership, and gap actions.
scores.nextFix: Regenerate as a true compliance matrix with columns for legal status, project-specific applicability, design impact, concrete evidence required, ownerRole, current gap, and next action; require UK-specific product rules including UK MDR classification rationale, Radio Equipment Regulations/EMC/RoHS/WEEE, battery UN 38.3 and IEC 62133-2, charger electrical safety, walking-stick mechanical standard verification, data/privacy and cybersecurity where applicable.

scores.summary: The regulatory section is empty, so it provides no project-mapped compliance matrix, UK-specific regulatory coverage, evidence requirements, or ownership.
scores.nextFix: Require the engine to output a populated UK-specific compliance matrix with one row per applicable regulation/standard, including applicability to Hedgerow design elements, statutory/reference status, design impact, concrete evidence required, ownerRole, and gap action.

scores.summary: This is largely a bibliography of partially relevant standards, with poor UK statutory/reference separation, no evidence artefacts, no owners, and major UK compliance gaps.
